messages:
Alex: Heads up — invoice preview spikes for a small tenant cohort after the route-enrich canary (rollout v0.3). Preview totals +14% vs baseline in the last 24h. Query & logs attached :eyes:
Maria: I can see the same in the console. Per-route emit_event latency has intermittent spikes around 21:14 UTC. A few tenants show doubled token counts.
Devon: Can you paste the query and which canary flags? We set route-enrich.parallel=2 last night.
Alex: Query we used for the quick check:
```
SELECT tenant_id, bucket(start_time, '1h') as hr, count(*) AS events, sum(tokens) AS tokens
FROM metering.events
WHERE start_time > now() - interval '48 hours' AND route = 'route-enrich'
GROUP BY tenant_id, hr
ORDER BY hr DESC
```
Maria: Logs show pairs of emit events with same edge_request_id arriving ~200ms apart: both accepted and counted. Looks like duplicate emission rather than a downstream re-ingestion.
Sam: @Devon this smells like the enrichment sidecar double-emitting when parallelism is enabled. We added idempotency header support but the emitter path might be missing it on the fastpath.
Devon: Right — I remember the fastpath skips the header plumb if the request comes from local cache. The emitter currently keys on local request-id, not X-Idempotency. I can push a fix to propagate X-Idempotency into emitter context.
Alex: We need an interim mitigation to avoid noisy invoice previews for enterprise customers. Any low-risk options?
Maria: We can add a short dedupe window in the aggregation/preview pipeline: drop exact-match edge_request_id within 1s. Minimal risk and reversible.
Sam: Agree. Also add a console alert if emit_event retries or duplicates > 2x baseline for >5m.
Devon: I'll open two PRs: (1) sidecar: ensure X-Idempotency propagation in fastpath, (2) metering: 1s dedupe filter for preview pipeline.
Devon: PRs: https://github.com/redwood/sidecar/pull/789 (propagate idempotency) and https://github.com/redwood/metering/pull/432 (preview dedupe) :lock:
ops-bot: deploy started for metering-dedupe v0.1 -> canary :rocket:
BillingBot: Note — invoice-preview service will apply temporary dedupe for affected tenants during canary window to avoid false invoices. See internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/dedupe-for-canary :memo:
Alex: 👍 Thanks team. Quick checklist for the 10m sync: rollback plan, backfill detection (recompute previews for 24h), alert thresholds, and PR owners.
Maria: I'll prepare the backfill query and set alert thresholds.
Sam: I'll draft rollback playbook in the runbook.
Devon: Patch landed in sidecar (staged). Will monitor canary logs after dedupe deploy.
Alex: Meeting in 10.
